extraFacts.fact: In Dixon Storz part numbers the digit pairs are sizes in tenths of an inch: 15 = 1-1/2 in, 20 = 2 in, 25 = 2-1/2 in, 30 = 3 in, 40 = 4 in, 45 = 4-1/2 in, 50 = 5 in, 60 = 6 in.
extraFacts.source: Dixon Valve & Coupling Storz part-number pattern, as shown by the item text of the elbow, rigid adapter and Storz x Storz rows (e.g. FSA2015S = 1-1/2 Inch Thread, SSA1520 = 1-1/2 x 2 Inch Storz Size)

extraFacts.fact: A Storz coupling is symmetrical: both halves are identical, so any Storz head mates with any other of the same Storz size, and a Storz size is identified by the distance across its lugs rather than by the hose bore.
extraFacts.source: Storz coupling pattern (DIN 14301 to 14327); Indus guide: Storz coupling sizes and lug distances

extraFacts.fact: NST (National Standard hose Thread) is the fire-hose thread used in the US; NPT is the US tapered pipe thread.

faqs.q: What are the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows are a 30 degree elbow with a Storz head and a female swivel (NST) thread, made by Dixon in aluminium, with 9 part numbers in the size table. Dixon states 150 psi (10 bar) for the range.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows, such as SFSA30-4060F?
faqs.a: In the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows table the two digits before the letter give the thread size in tenths of an inch: SFSA30-4060F ends in 60 for a 6" thread and SFSA30-4050F ends in 50 for a 5" thread. The -LH suffix marks the long-handle version and every elbow here has an NST thread.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows come in?
faqs.a: The Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows are listed with threads of 3", 4", 4-1/2", 5" and 6" on Storz sizes 4" and 5", nine part numbers in all. Pick the part number whose Storz size matches the head and whose thread matches the line.

faqs.q: Which handle options do the Dixon Storz x female swivel 30 degree elbows have?
faqs.a: The Dixon 30 degree elbows come with a rocker lug or with long handles: SFSA30-4060F has rocker lugs and a 6 in thread, while SFSA30-4045F-LH has long handles and a 4-1/2 in thread. Long handles give more leverage to tighten the swivel by hand; rocker lugs are the standard pattern.

faqs.q: What pressure are the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows rated for?
faqs.a: Dixon states 150 psi (10 bar) for the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows, and every row of the table carries it. That is a low working pressure, so use these adapters on hose lines rated no higher and check the other fittings in the line.

faqs.q: What material and seal do the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows have?
faqs.a: The Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows are aluminium, with a nitrile rubber (Buna-N) seal according to the listing. Nitrile suits water and many oils but not every chemical, so tell us the fluid and temperature if it is not water.

faqs.q: Is there a standard or certificate for the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows?
faqs.a: The listing for the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows names no standard and attaches no certificate. Dixon is a US maker, and the country of origin shown is the United States. If your project needs a certificate or test report, ask us and we request it from the maker with the order.

faqs.q: What does the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows connect to?
faqs.a: The Storz head of the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows mates with any Storz head of the same Storz size, since Storz is symmetrical, and the other end here mates with a female-threaded pipe or fitting. Storz does not connect to cam and groove couplings without an adapter; see our [Storz coupling size guide](/blog/storz-coupling-sizes).

faqs.q: How are the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows installed and checked?
faqs.a: For the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows, check the gasket in the Storz face before each connection, press the heads together and turn until the lugs lock, and tighten the threaded end on the pipe or fitting. A damaged gasket is the usual cause of a leak, so replace it rather than reuse a cut or flattened one.

faqs.q: How do the Dixon Storz x Female Swivel 30 Degree Elbows differ from the straight swivel adapters?
